hosted.update.title: Update your wholesale application
hosted.update.intro: {store} needs a little more information to review your wholesale application.
hosted.update.doneHeading: Thank you, your application has been updated
hosted.update.doneBody: {store} will review it and get back to you by email.
hosted.link.invalidBody: Check that you opened the whole link from the email, or contact {store}.
hosted.link.expiredBody: For your security, update links only work for a limited time. Please contact {store} and ask for a new link.
hosted.link.usedTitle: This link has already been used
hosted.link.usedBody: Each update link works once. If you need to change something else, please contact {store}.
hosted.noscript: Please turn on JavaScript in your browser to update your application.
hosted.error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.
